The corpus now feeds and improves itself.

- **`scripts/maintain.py`** — one scheduled command: scrape next sources (round-robin),
  backfill culture/years/glosses, canonicalize, fold all human annotations into
  consensus constraints, recluster. Cron it weekly and the platform runs itself.
- Nightly backup script + cron recipes in `deploy/DEPLOY.md`.
- Scraped-page ads and navigation debris are now filtered before entering the corpus.
